title: From one seed to a graded page
post:
Keyword research, a brief and a page grade - from real searches in one market.

Input: 'emergency dentist', US. Output: 90 real searches, a brief, and a 54/100 grade for the live page.

13 autocomplete lookups (13 answered), 11 phrasings about other countries dropped, grouped into 45 questions / 17 local / 14 buying / 14 learning.
Words to use: dental, open, tomorrow - not 'nyc' for a page about Williamsville.
#ContentMarketing #SEO

title: From a map to an honest first message
post:
Lead generation without lying to the lead.

Input: dentist, Manchester, UK. Output: 49 ranked leads and honest first messages.

OpenStreetMap (1 request/second) → 49 businesses, 13 with a website → each site checked once → ranked by what they stand to gain.
A chain branch is matched to its brand's site instead of being told 'you have no website'. A site that didn't answer is never quoted.
Drafts quote only what the check found.
#LeadGeneration #Sales

title: Local SEO for the right market
post:
Local SEO, checked for the market the business is actually in.

Input: pizzeriabianco.com (Phoenix). Output: 56/100.

The country comes from the address, phone code or domain - so a US restaurant is not told to add a WhatsApp link.
Phone numbers read whole from the page: three of them, and no LocalBusiness data to carry any.
12 checks: 1 fail (schema), 8 warnings, 3 pass. A Facebook page is not counted as a review link.
#LocalSEO

title: Rankloom, end to end
output: a typed result view, saved to the dashboard
post:
Rankloom: seven tools in one private web app - Site Audit, AI Visibility, Lead Finder, Search Performance, Content Studio, Client Reports and Job Radar.

Python standard library only: http.server, sqlite3, scrypt, RFC 6238 2-step codes. Every outbound request goes through an address guard (public IPs, ports 80/443, pinned sockets).
18 sub-tools share one output contract, so one renderer draws them all. 173 tests.
#Python #WebSecurity #SEO

title: Search Console, as a work list
post:
Search Console data, turned into a work list with the clicks at stake.

Input: a Search Console export (28 days vs previous). Output: 7 near-page-one queries, 3 under-clicked, the losers and gainers.

One total everywhere (1,287 clicks, from the Pages table). 'dentist williamsville ny' at position 4.2 gets 2.5% CTR where 8% is typical: ~132 clicks a period to win. Clicks 1,332 → 1,287, mostly that query slipping from 2.8 to 4.2.
#SEO #GoogleSearchConsole

title: Page Check, layer by layer
post:
What happens inside a one-page SEO audit, from address to score.

Input: amherstdental.com. Output: 91/100 - 18 checks pass, 2 warn, 1 fails.

1. The server checks the session and the request's origin.
2. An address guard allows public addresses on ports 80/443 only, re-checking every redirect.
3. One fetch (3 MB cap, 15 s): it answered in 3,349 ms.
4. The parser reads the title, headings, JSON-LD and 1,697 words of text.
5. 21 checks run; pass earns full weight, a warning half.
6. The failure comes first - with the note that speed was measured from our server, not the visitor's.

Part of Rankloom, a private workspace for selling SEO and AI-visibility work.
#SEO #WebPerformance #Python

title: A crawl, page by page
post:
A site crawl that tells the truth about what it found.

Input: amherstdental.com, limit 10 pages. Output: 84/100.

robots.txt first (obeyed), the sitemap listed 166 pages, 10 read in 12.6 s through the same address guard as a single-page check.
Findings across pages: 7 of 10 titles over 60 characters (longest 129), 1 page with no description, 1 page over 2.5 s.
Every finding names its pages - and a check that finds a problem never says Pass.
#SEO #TechnicalSEO
